description: 100 real-world engineer scenarios — the kind of questions on-call SREs, platform engineers, and security folks actually type during incidents, capacity reviews, audits, and weekly status preps. First 20 preserved verbatim from incident-scenarios-20.json; remaining 80 extend coverage into blast radius, drift, dependencies, forensics, cost, observability gaps, and narrative reporting. Cluster: kubilitics-test (kind, 3 nodes, 7 namespaces, demo/web + data/redis workloads).

prompts.text: Give me a quick health check of the whole cluster — what's running, what's broken, what should I worry about right now?
prompts.scenario: Just-got-paged overview. Engineer wants one-shot situational awareness before digging in.

prompts.text: Is anything unhealthy in the demo namespace? If so, what and why?
prompts.scenario: Scoped triage. Engineer knows the service area; wants targeted assessment without reading every pod manually.

prompts.text: Show me the web deployment in demo — how many replicas, are they all ready, any recent restarts?
prompts.scenario: Deployment-level status question that drives downstream 'is my service serving traffic?' reasoning.

prompts.text: Any pods that have restarted more than once in the last hour? I need to know before standup.
prompts.scenario: Flake detector. Engineer is looking for the 'silent failures' — services that are technically up but thrashing.

prompts.text: Grab the latest logs from one of the web pods in demo — I want to see if there's anything funny in the output.
prompts.scenario: Fast log peek. Engineer doesn't want to kubectl exec; the assistant should pick a representative pod.

prompts.text: What errors or warnings are showing up in redis in the data namespace recently?
prompts.scenario: Filtered log investigation. Tests whether the assistant fetches logs AND summarizes, not just dumps lines.

prompts.text: What happened in the demo namespace in the last 15 minutes? Any events I should know about?
prompts.scenario: Event-based forensics — 'what changed' is usually the first question during an incident.

prompts.text: Have any pods been OOMKilled or evicted cluster-wide recently?
prompts.scenario: Resource-pressure red flag. Engineer is hunting for silent memory issues before they cascade.

prompts.text: Are any of my nodes under pressure — CPU, memory, disk? I don't want to find out by being paged.
prompts.scenario: Capacity pre-emption. The question a seasoned SRE asks BEFORE a capacity incident, not after.

prompts.text: How is the kubilitics-test-control-plane node doing — capacity, what's scheduled on it, any conditions?
prompts.scenario: Specific-node deep dive. Tests whether the assistant can focus on one node without dumping cluster-wide data.

prompts.text: Do I have enough capacity to scale the web deployment from 3 to 10 replicas? Give me a realistic answer.
prompts.scenario: What-if capacity planning. Requires reasoning about node resources + existing allocations, not just listing.

prompts.text: Who has permission to delete pods in the demo namespace? I need to know for a security review.
prompts.scenario: Real RBAC audit scenario. The answer should name service accounts / roles, not just dump policy docs.

prompts.text: Are any service accounts granted cluster-admin by accident? That'd be a finding I need to escalate.
prompts.scenario: Security-posture check. The SRE equivalent of 'is the door unlocked?'

prompts.text: The web service in demo — where does its traffic go? Which pods does it actually route to right now?
prompts.scenario: Service/endpoints correlation. Helps debug 'service exists but nothing responds' issues.

prompts.text: What persistent volumes exist and are any close to full or in an error state?
prompts.scenario: Storage-pressure scan. PVC-full is a classic silent incident cause; the assistant should flag it proactively.

prompts.text: Show me the environment variables the redis pod in data is running with — I suspect a config mismatch.
prompts.scenario: Config drift debugging. Critical: the assistant must redact secret values while showing the shape.

prompts.text: Walk me through everything the redis deployment depends on — configmaps, secrets, service accounts, the works.
prompts.scenario: Dependency discovery. Tests multi-step reasoning: get deployment → trace refs → read each ref.

prompts.text: Compare the web deployment's desired state to what's actually running — anything different?
prompts.scenario: Drift detection. Exercises the 'desired vs actual' mental model that Kubernetes operators live in.

prompts.text: What's been deployed or changed in the last 2 hours? I came back from lunch and things feel off.
prompts.scenario: Recent-change investigation. Nearly every incident starts with 'what changed?' — this is the core question.

prompts.text: Summarize the kubilitics-test cluster for a weekly status update — what's deployed, who's healthy, any risks to flag.
prompts.scenario: Narrative-style reporting. Tests whether the assistant can synthesize across multiple tools into a human-readable summary.

prompts.text: I just got paged — redis, data namespace. What's going on right now?
prompts.scenario: The literal first 30 seconds of an incident — engineer needs immediate context on a named service.

prompts.text: Anything in the cluster stuck in a non-Running state? Pending, CrashLooping, ImagePullBackOff, whatever.
prompts.scenario: Broad sweep for stuck pods across all namespaces before standup.

prompts.text: Are all my system pods in kube-system happy? If kube-dns or the API server is flaky I need to know first.
prompts.scenario: Control-plane sanity check — rules out infra problems before chasing app-level issues.

prompts.text: Give me the top 3 things that look wrong right now, ranked by how much I should care.
prompts.scenario: Prioritized triage. Tests whether the model can rank severity, not just list.

prompts.text: Is the cluster actually serving traffic? Not 'are pods Running' — I mean are endpoints healthy end-to-end.
prompts.scenario: Beyond-pod-status reasoning — distinguishing Pod Ready from Service actually serving.

prompts.text: Anything flapping? I want to catch services that keep going Ready then NotReady.
prompts.scenario: Flap hunt — the silent killer that Prometheus alerting often misses until customers complain.

prompts.text: Quick sanity check before I hand off on-call — anything the next person needs to know?
prompts.scenario: End-of-shift handoff — forces the assistant to surface only what's actionable.

prompts.text: What's the single biggest risk in this cluster right now? One thing, not a list.
prompts.scenario: Force-rank question — most useful during a war-room where focus matters.

prompts.text: Is anything degraded but not outright broken? The grey-zone stuff is what bites.
prompts.scenario: Captures the partial-failure reality of real production — not Red or Green.

prompts.text: I'm about to go into a customer demo in 10 minutes. Anything in this cluster that will embarrass me?
prompts.scenario: Pre-demo jitters — classic time-pressured sanity check.

prompts.text: The frontend is slow. Web pods in demo — CPU or memory pinned on any of them?
prompts.scenario: Performance triage. Direct quote from the calibration example list.

prompts.text: Any pods without resource requests set? I keep getting scheduling issues and I think that's the cause.
prompts.scenario: Config-hygiene check — missing requests are one of the top causes of scheduling chaos.

prompts.text: Are any pods in demo way over-provisioned? I want to trim the fat before finance asks.
prompts.scenario: Rightsizing question — requests vs actual usage comparison.

prompts.text: Is the web deployment actually running the image I think it is? I want to confirm the tag.
prompts.scenario: Post-deploy verification — did my rollout actually take effect.

prompts.text: Any pod that's been Pending for more than 5 minutes? Something's wrong if so.
prompts.scenario: Scheduler starvation hunt — Pending pods are almost always a signal, not noise.

prompts.text: How many times has the redis pod in data restarted since it was created? Is that a lot for its age?
prompts.scenario: Restart-rate reasoning — requires normalization by uptime, not just raw count.

prompts.text: Any of the web pods stuck on a single node? I want them spread for HA.
prompts.scenario: Anti-affinity / topology spread audit — common post-incident finding.

prompts.text: Check if redis has liveness and readiness probes configured, and whether they're actually passing.
prompts.scenario: Probe configuration audit — missing probes is a top-5 reliability smell.

prompts.text: Which pod in demo has used the most CPU in the last 30 minutes?
prompts.scenario: Hot-pod identification — classic 'who is eating my lunch' question.

prompts.text: Is any container in the cluster running without a memory limit? That's an accident waiting to happen.
prompts.scenario: Memory-limit hygiene — unbounded containers can tip entire nodes.

prompts.text: The web deployment — is HPA attached, and if yes what's it currently targeting?
prompts.scenario: HPA configuration check — common during scale investigations.

prompts.text: Any pod that's been in Terminating state for more than a minute? Those usually mean a stuck finalizer.
prompts.scenario: Stuck-terminating hunt — classic operator bug signature.

prompts.text: I'm seeing 500s from web — look through the recent web pod logs and tell me what's throwing errors.
prompts.scenario: Error-hunt in logs — requires filtering + summarizing, not dumping.

prompts.text: Find any 'panic' or 'fatal' strings in any pod logs across the cluster in the last hour.
prompts.scenario: Keyword-triggered forensics — broad-sweep log scan during major incidents.

prompts.text: Grab the previous container logs for the redis pod — I think it restarted and I want the crash output.
prompts.scenario: Post-crash forensics — --previous is the flag you only remember after you need it.

prompts.text: Did any pod get OOMKilled between roughly 2:15 and 2:45 today?
prompts.scenario: Time-bounded forensics — matches a known alert window.

prompts.text: Any FailedScheduling events in the last hour? Which pods and why?
prompts.scenario: Scheduling-failure investigation — commonly a capacity or taint problem.

prompts.text: What warning-level events are showing up cluster-wide? Ignore the routine Normal stuff.
prompts.scenario: Noise-filtered event scan — separates signal from Kubernetes chatter.

prompts.text: Any image pull failures anywhere? Registry might be flaking again.
prompts.scenario: Registry-trouble hunt — a common source of mysterious 'pods won't start' pages.

prompts.text: Has anything been BackOff'd more than 3 times in the last hour? That's basically a broken pod.
prompts.scenario: Backoff-threshold alert — specific quantitative trigger.

prompts.text: How much headroom do I have on each node? CPU and memory available after requests.
prompts.scenario: Classic capacity-remaining question for scheduling decisions.

prompts.text: Any node that's running way hotter than the others? I want to catch imbalance early.
prompts.scenario: Load imbalance — often surfaces before outright node failure.

prompts.text: Are all three of my nodes Ready and schedulable? No cordons, no taints I didn't put there?
prompts.scenario: Scheduler-input audit — cordons/taints cause surprise Pending pods.

prompts.text: If one node dies right now, do I have room to reschedule everything on the other two?
prompts.scenario: N-1 capacity planning — the scenario every enterprise architect asks.

prompts.text: Which pods are running on kubilitics-test-worker? I want to see what I'd lose if that node fell over.
prompts.scenario: Blast-radius-per-node — classic failure domain review.

prompts.text: Are any pods with no PDB pinned to a single node? Those are my cascading-failure risks.
prompts.scenario: PDB + topology-spread cross-check — real DR hygiene.

prompts.text: Can we absorb a 2x traffic surge without adding nodes? Black Friday is coming.
prompts.scenario: Capacity planning with a business deadline — forces forward-looking math.

prompts.text: Which node has the most pods and the least resources free? That's my next incident.
prompts.scenario: Hotspot identification — proactive rather than reactive.

prompts.text: Does any role outside kube-system have wildcard permissions? Quarterly audit needs a clean answer.
prompts.scenario: Wildcard-perm audit — classic compliance finding.

prompts.text: Which service accounts can read secrets cluster-wide? That's a blast-radius question for a SOC2 prep.
prompts.scenario: Secrets-read audit — high-leverage permission to track.

prompts.text: Is there any workload running as root? Our baseline says no and I want to confirm.
prompts.scenario: Pod-security baseline audit — runAsNonRoot enforcement check.

prompts.text: Any pod with hostPath mounts? Those are almost always a risk to call out.
prompts.scenario: HostPath audit — node-escape risk surface.

prompts.text: Which namespaces have ImagePullSecrets configured vs not? Trying to understand our registry auth posture.
prompts.scenario: Registry-auth audit — often drifts silently.

prompts.text: Do we have any privileged containers anywhere? That's a hard-no in our policy.
prompts.scenario: Privileged-container detector — a top PSP / Pod Security Standards violation.

prompts.text: Are network policies in place for demo and data namespaces? We've been meaning to lock those down.
prompts.scenario: NetworkPolicy coverage audit — default-open namespaces are a common finding.

prompts.text: Security prep for the BigCorp onboarding call tomorrow — give me the quick-wins and the known gaps.
prompts.scenario: Customer-facing security review — forces positive AND negative framing.

prompts.text: Any secret in the cluster older than 90 days that probably should've been rotated?
prompts.scenario: Secret-age check — rotation-policy enforcement hint.

prompts.text: Is DNS working properly inside the cluster? I'm seeing weird resolve failures from web.
prompts.scenario: CoreDNS health debugging — a frequent root cause of 'random' app failures.

prompts.text: Any service in the cluster with zero endpoints? That's a broken selector.
prompts.scenario: Zero-endpoint services — silent routing black holes.

prompts.text: What ingresses do we have and are their backends all healthy?
prompts.scenario: Ingress-to-backend correlation — external-traffic readiness check.

prompts.text: Is the web service in demo reachable from the data namespace? Suspect a NetworkPolicy blocking it.
prompts.scenario: Cross-namespace reachability — NetworkPolicy debugging scenario.

prompts.text: Show me all LoadBalancer and NodePort services. I want to know what's exposed externally.
prompts.scenario: External-surface audit — useful for security reviews and cost tracking.

prompts.text: Explain why billing would depend on auth — trace the service wiring so I can understand the blast radius if auth goes down.
prompts.scenario: Service dependency mapping — architectural blast-radius exercise.

prompts.text: Any ingress with a TLS cert about to expire? I don't want to be that person on a Friday.
prompts.scenario: Cert-expiry pre-check — classic Friday-saver.

prompts.text: Any PVC stuck in Pending? Means the StorageClass or a provisioner is sideways.
prompts.scenario: PVC-pending hunt — common dev-cluster and prod pain point.

prompts.text: Which PVs use the local-path StorageClass and how much space is used vs allocated?
prompts.scenario: Storage-usage drill — kind cluster uses local-path, so this is grounded.

prompts.text: Any PVC that's been Released but not Deleted? Those hold capacity hostage.
prompts.scenario: Reclaim-policy audit — finds orphaned claims.

prompts.text: If redis's PVC filled up right now, what would happen? Walk me through it.
prompts.scenario: What-if storage exhaustion — forces reasoning about app behavior, not just K8s objects.

prompts.text: What's the retention policy on each PV? Do any say Delete when they should be Retain?
prompts.scenario: ReclaimPolicy audit — critical before any cluster rebuild.

prompts.text: If I delete the web configmap in demo right now, what breaks?
prompts.scenario: Blast-radius question against a specific config object — pure impact analysis.

prompts.text: Find any configmap referenced by a deployment but that doesn't actually exist. Those are silent landmines.
prompts.scenario: Dangling-reference hunt — pods boot but don't reload properly.

prompts.text: Are there any secrets mounted into pods that aren't actually used by the container? Smell of leftover config.
prompts.scenario: Unused-secret audit — surface-area reduction.

prompts.text: Diff the live web deployment against what looks like its declared manifest — is there env drift?
prompts.scenario: Live-vs-declared drift — GitOps hygiene check.

prompts.text: Which pods mount the same secret? If that secret rotates, I want the blast radius.
prompts.scenario: Secret-consumer mapping — rotation-planning primitive.

prompts.text: Show me the shape of all env vars on the web pod in demo — don't print secret values, just the keys.
prompts.scenario: Structured-config inspection — must redact values.

prompts.text: Any pod still referencing a ConfigMap from a namespace that was deleted? I'm chasing a stale binding theory.
prompts.scenario: Stale-binding forensics — obscure but real operator-introduced bug.

prompts.text: Did anything get deployed in the last hour? PagerDuty just lit up and I need to know what changed.
prompts.scenario: Direct calibration-example quote — the archetypal 'what changed' question.

prompts.text: Are there any deployments currently mid-rollout? I want to know if we're in a partial state.
prompts.scenario: Active-rollout detector — in-flight changes are their own category of risk.

prompts.text: Did the web deployment's image tag change in the last 24 hours? Show me old vs new.
prompts.scenario: Tag-diff question — GitOps / audit angle.

prompts.text: Was anything scaled up or down in demo recently? I'm trying to explain a cost spike.
prompts.scenario: Scale-event forensics — cost-driven investigation.

prompts.text: Roll me through redis's rollout history — how many revisions, any rollbacks?
prompts.scenario: Revision history review — standard during rollout postmortems.

prompts.text: If I roll the web deployment back one revision, what would that actually revert?
prompts.scenario: What-if rollback — spec-level diff reasoning.

prompts.text: Which namespace is eating the most CPU this week? Finance is asking and I need a number.
prompts.scenario: Namespace-level cost attribution — common monthly ritual.

prompts.text: Any workloads that request a lot of memory but barely use any? That's the rightsizing backlog.
prompts.scenario: Requests vs usage gap — classic waste signal.

prompts.text: Are there any deployments scaled above 1 replica that haven't served real traffic in a week?
prompts.scenario: Idle-replica identification — cost-reduction opportunity.

prompts.text: Give me an estimate of how much slack CPU we have paid for but aren't using across the cluster.
prompts.scenario: Cluster-level slack — feeds into quarterly capacity conversations.

prompts.text: Which services don't have liveness probes? We can't page on what we can't detect.
prompts.scenario: Probe-coverage audit — basic observability hygiene.

prompts.text: Any pod without the standard Prometheus scrape annotations? I want to know where our metrics gap is.
prompts.scenario: Metrics-coverage audit — observability-stack hygiene.

prompts.text: Which namespaces have zero logs flowing to our aggregator in the last hour? Either nothing's running or logging's broken.
prompts.scenario: Log-coverage gap — catches silent log-pipeline failures.

prompts.text: Put together a postmortem-style narrative of what happened in the cluster in the last hour — even if nothing bad, just the story.
prompts.scenario: Narrative forensics — mixes events + changes + health into one story.
